text:
Alex: Quick thought — do we want an early fallback lint that rejects models with more than X incompat warnings?
Sophia: +1 on a lint but can we scope to only ABI-affecting warnings? bandwidth is limited.
Nick: If we lint too hard we'll block community models. Maybe make it a warn-by-default rule with opt-in enforcement for dedicated/private tiers.
Tanvi: Thoughts on sampling: smoke set vs stratified small bench. The lint could run on smoke only, full bench later.
Maria: Agree. Smoke lint for admit gate, full bench for post-admit quality/regression alerts.
Alex: ops-bot: prebench pipeline v2 applied — heads up for layout changes.
ops-bot: prebench run started for model abc123 (run_id=pb-2024-04-05-7)
Sophia: Important to capture KV-cache mismatch warnings too — agents saw subtle decode diffs when cache keys shuffled.
Nick: KV mismatch -> treat as compat alert not block, but escalate to oncall if >5% mismatch rate.
Tanvi: Proposal: add a 'compat-lint.yaml' opt-in config, defaults:
```
block_on: [abi_failures]
warn_on: [kv_mismatch, float_overflow, shape_change]
sample: stratified(200)
```
Maria: Nice. Also need a short-circuit fallback plan: if we fail at runtime, route to fallback 'redwood-small' with preserved prompt context.
Alex: Implementation notes: lint runs in ingest-sandbox, emits metrics to /metrics/model_lint.* so console can show fail/warn counts.
Sophia: UX ask — expose a 'lint score' in registry listing (green/yellow/red) + last-run timestamp.
Nick: For rollout: enforce block_on for private/dedicated customers after a 2-week opt-in period; hosted stays warn-by-default.
Tanvi: Can someone spin a quick RFC PR with config schema and the gating flow? I'm happy to review.
Maria: I'll open it tonight, include sample pipeline YAML and backwards-compat heuristics.
Alex: Sweet. If no objections we'll start a small canary run next week on 3 community models. :shipit:
